skillgap.title: Skill Gap Assessment
skillgap.subtitle: View your competencies based on your initial assessment.
skillgap.q1: I can draw an end-to-end process map for an unfamiliar workflow.
skillgap.q2: I can independently spot edge-case safety or quality regressions in existing systems.
skillgap.q3: I know how to run a structured 5-Whys or fishbone analysis to find true root causes.
skillgap.q4: I can trace logs, metrics, or artifacts back to their source without getting lost.
skillgap.q5: I can write a crisp 1-page technical memo outlining an incident, root cause, and next steps.
skillgap.q6: I understand how to design and evaluate features to avoid bias and ensure fairness.
skillgap.radarLegend: Blue/Teal — your current level. Outer borders — target proficiency
skillgap.noHighRatings: No High ratings yet — keep practicing.
skillgap.fb1: Capable of mapping and optimizing workflows.
skillgap.fb2: Skilled at isolating critical system threats.
skillgap.fb3: Mastery of incident debug and 5-Why root-cause flows.
skillgap.fb4: Rigidly links features, code reviews, and automated builds.
skillgap.fb6: Proactively inspects prompts and LLM security constraints.
skillgap.rec1act: Workshop: Mapping a production line using SIPOC + swimlane diagrams.
skillgap.rec2: Need guidelines to rank vulnerability scores.
skillgap.rec2act: Module: FMEA + 5-Why for a packaging-line near-miss case.
skillgap.rec3: Easily treat symptoms rather than root bugs.
skillgap.rec3act: Scenario S-102 — Database pool exhaustion: build the full RCA tree.
skillgap.rec4: Lacks clean traceability indexes in test scripts.
skillgap.rec4act: Lab: Build a traceability matrix linking requirements → tests → defects.
skillgap.rec5: Need to clarify writing style for non-tech audiences.
skillgap.rec5act: Practice: Draft a post-mortem memo for the Checkout API outage.
skillgap.rec6: Prone to blindly copying third-party chatbot answers.
skillgap.rec6act: Quiz: Responsible AI checklist + redaction practice on sample prompts.

aiquiz.title: AI Occupation Simulator Quiz
quiz.title: Initial Skill Gap Assessment
quiz.q1: How comfortable are you with drawing end-to-end process maps?
quiz.q1_opt1: I don't know how to create process maps.
quiz.q1_opt2: I can create basic flowcharts but struggle with complex workflows.
quiz.q1_opt3: I can confidently draw detailed end-to-end process maps for unfamiliar workflows.
quiz.q2: How would you rate your ability to identify safety and quality risks?
quiz.q2_opt1: I rarely consider edge-case safety regressions.
quiz.q2_opt2: I can identify common risks but might miss complex system interactions.
quiz.q2_opt3: I can independently spot edge-case safety or quality regressions in existing systems.
quiz.q3: How experienced are you with Root Cause Analysis (RCA)?
quiz.q3_opt1: I usually just fix the immediate bug without structured analysis.
quiz.q3_opt2: I know what RCA is but haven't run structured 5-Whys or fishbone reviews.
quiz.q3_opt3: I know how to run a structured 5-Whys or fishbone analysis to find true root causes.
quiz.q4: How well can you trace artifacts back to their source?
quiz.q4_opt1: I find it difficult to connect requirements with code and tests.
quiz.q4_opt2: I can somewhat trace artifacts but sometimes get lost in complex systems.
quiz.q4_opt3: I can trace logs, metrics, or artifacts back to their source without getting lost.
quiz.q5: How comfortable are you writing technical incident memos?
quiz.q5_opt1: I have never written a technical incident report.
quiz.q5_opt2: I can write a report but it's often unstructured or too detailed.
quiz.q5_opt3: I can write a crisp 1-page technical memo outlining an incident, root cause, and next steps.
quiz.q6: How well do you understand Responsible AI practices?
quiz.q6_opt1: I am unfamiliar with designing features for fairness and avoiding bias.
quiz.q6_opt2: I have a basic understanding but lack practical experience evaluating AI bias.
quiz.q6_opt3: I understand how to design and evaluate features to avoid bias and ensure fairness.
